params.name: startPoint
params.description: Start Point in 'Lat,Long,coordsys' format.

params.name: endPoint
params.description: End Point in 'Lat,Long,coordsys' format.

params.name: db
params.description: Mode of commute.

params.name: intermediatePoints
params.description: List of intermediate points of the route.

params.name: returnIntermediatePoints
params.description: returnIntermediatePoints route.

params.name: oip
params.description: Specifies whether waypoints need to be optimized.

params.name: destinationSrs
params.description: Specifies the desired coordinate system of the returned route.

params.name: optimizeBy
params.description: Specifies whether the route should be optimized by time or distance.

params.name: returnDistance
params.description: Specifies whether distance needs to be part of direction information in response.

params.name: distanceUnit
params.description: Return Distance Unit such as ft(Foot), km(Kilometer), mi(Mile), m(Meter) or yd(Yard).

params.name: returnTime
params.description: Specifies whether time needs to be part of direction information in response.

params.name: timeUnit
params.description: Return time unit such as min(Minute), h(Hour), s(Second) or msec(Millisecond)

params.name: language
params.description: Specifies the language of travel directions.

params.name: directionsStyle
params.description: Specifies whether route directions text is to be returned in the response and in what detail (Normal or Terse).

params.name: segmentGeometryStyle
params.description: Specifies whether the route geometry is to be returned in the response and in what detail (End or All).

params.name: primaryNameOnly
params.description: If true then only the primary street name is returned otherwise all the names for a street.

params.name: majorRoads
params.description: Whether to include all roads in route calculation or just major roads.

params.name: historicTrafficTimeBucket
params.description: Specifies whether routing calculation uses the historic traffic speeds.

params.name: returnDirectionGeometry
params.description: Whether to include geometry associated with each route instruction in response.

params.name: useCvr
params.description: This parameter will enable/disable CVR (Commercial Vehicle Restrictions) capability in our APIs.

params.name: looseningBarrierRestrictions
params.description: Specifies that barriers will be removed when determining the route.

params.name: vehicleType
params.description: vehicle type.

params.name: weight
params.description: Specifies the maximum weight of a vehicle. Any vehicles over this value will be restricted when determining the route.

params.name: weightUnit
params.description: The unit of weight eg. kg(kilogram), lb(pound), mt(metric ton), t(ton).

params.name: height
params.description: Specifies the maximum height of a vehicle. Any vehicles over this value will be restricted when determining the route.

params.name: heightUnit
params.description: The unit of height e.g m(meter), km(kilometer), yd(yard), ft(foot), mi(mile).

params.name: length
params.description: Specifies the maximum length of a vehicle. Any vehicles over this value will be restricted when determining the route.

params.name: lengthUnit
params.description: The unit of length eg. m(meter), km(kilometer), yd(yard), ft(foot), mi(mile).

params.name: width
params.description: Specifies the maximum width of a vehicle. Any vehicles over this value will be restricted when determining the route.

params.name: widthUnit
params.description: The unit of width eg. m(meter), km(kilometer), yd(yard), ft(foot), mi(mile).
